title: DocuMastery Best Practices
content: DocuMastery Best Practices: 1. Categorize documents by case number and client name. 2. Use a consistent naming convention for all files. 3. Keep a log of document updates and revisions. 4. Regularly back up important files. 5. Ensure all documents are properly encrypted and access is restricted based on role. 6. Conduct periodic reviews to dispose of outdated documents.

title: Identity Change Process for Jane Roe
content: Identity Change Process for Jane Roe: Case File #7643 - Legal name change documentation, social security number update forms, and new identification numbers. Note: All documents are sealed as per court order due to the sensitive nature of the case involving a sexual assault survivor.
